ios.desc:
Cleaning up your photo library doesn’t have to be a tedious chore. With Purgo, you can declutter at your own pace while rediscovering forgotten moments along the way.

PHOTO CLEANING
• Review photos at your own pace - your progress is automatically saved
• Get rid of similar looking photos
• Easily mark photos to keep or delete while browsing your library
• Focus on specific categories: large files, screenshots, videos, and more
• Create custom categories within a specific date range or at a particular location to target your cleanup
• Preview surrounding photos to make better decisions about similar shots
• Photos marked for deletion move to the "Trash" tab first, so you can review them before emptying it

REDISCOVER FORGOTTEN MOMENTS
• Fully interact with your photos - zoom, share, and relive cherished memories
• Browse freely without being forced to review every photo on the spot
• Organize as you go - create albums, hide photos, or mark favorites

ALBUM MANAGEMENT
• Go through your albums the same way you clean other categories
• Remove all empty albums with a single tap
• Create and edit albums directly within the app
• Sync custom categories to albums in your Photos app automatically

SEAMLESSLY INTEGRATED WITH iOS
• Even after emptying the trash, deleted photos remain in the system Photos app in the "Recently Deleted" album for 30 days
• All changes are automatically synced with the iOS Photos app
• Control mobile data usage when downloading photos from iCloud
• A simple, intuitive interface that puts your photos first
• Free up storage space while keeping what truly matters

PRIVACY MATTERS
• Your photos and videos never leave your device
• You can revoke access to your photo library anytime in iOS settings

Declutter your phone today and rediscover your favorite memories along the way.


---

quotes.text:
Hello HN!

Driven by the desire to avoid upgrading to the 2TB iCloud tier, I made a photo cleaning app for iOS that helps you systematically review your photos. While there are many similar apps, none of them checked all the boxes for what I wanted:

- Clear privacy guarantee that photos never leave your device

- Being honest about free limit usage. Some apps let you review photos only to reveal you can delete just a couple per day when you try to empty the trash. Basically taking your time hostage, when you've already gone through hundreds of photos

- Context for better decisions. A lot of the apps use swipe-based UIs that only show one photo at a time, making it hard/impossible to see surrounding photos to make a proper decision

- An enjoyable experience with features like zooming and sharing. You should be able to have fun and relive your memories, given you are already doing the tedious task of going through hundreds of photos

I hope that these factors illustrate why I decided to enter this crowded space with my own take.
Thank you for your time, and if you consider giving it a look, I would definitely appreciate any feedback.

Tony
